title: EntityProfileChangedPayload
description: Payload of the EntityProfileChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9); node added by INV-T-3298 (INV-API-3327, INV-Q-3324 (a)). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity whose profile changed.

changedAttributes.description: Each attribute that changed, old and new value as sent (opaque strings; consumers compare, not interpret).

oldValue.description: Value before the change, absent when the attribute was previously unset.

effectiveDate.description: Date the changed profile takes effect.

node.description: The node's full state after the change, the same node object getEntityStructure returns (INV-Q-3324 (a), INV-API-3327). A consumer replaces the node whole from it; the newest structureVersion holds every earlier change, so the order between the two structure topics does not matter. Absent only on a 1.0-shaped event.

kind.description: The node's level (INV-REQ-850). Authoritative: a consumer reads the node's level from kind.

parentRef.description: The node's parent after the change; absent for a tenant.

retired.description: True once the node is retired. Authoritative for every kind.

name.description: The node's name: an entity's or tenant's legal name, a group's or business unit's name.

code.description: The short code of a registered entity or business unit (A-Z, 0-9, 1 to 10 characters, unique within the tenant; INV-REQ-850 b7); absent for a tenant or group.

profile.description: The node's profile as effective-dated attribute entries (INV-REQ-323, INV-REQ-376, INV-REQ-852): every entry in force or scheduled, so a consumer serves an attribute for a given date by its effective date and never serves a future-dated entry before its date. Empty when the node has no profile attributes.

items.description: One attribute value and the date from which it takes effect.

attribute.description: Attribute name, e.g. legalName, gstRegistrationNumber, filingFrequency.

value.description: The attribute's value from effectiveDate, as sent (an opaque string; consumers compare, not interpret).

effectiveDate.description: Date from which value takes effect.

structureVersion.description: tenancy-svc's monotonic structure version of this node state: one sequence across OrganisationStructureChanged, EntityProfileChanged and getEntityStructure, drawn after tenancy-svc locks the node row in the changing transaction, so versions per node follow commit order (TPL-05). A replica replaces the node whole and ignores a state at or below the version it holds (INV-Q-3324).
